verse.verse_1: When the heaven is cleft asunder,
verse.verse_3: When the seas are poured forth,
verse.verse_5: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.
verse.verse_6: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
verse.verse_7: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?
verse.verse_8: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.
verse.verse_9: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.
verse.verse_10: Lo! there are above you guardians,
verse.verse_13: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.
verse.verse_14: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;
verse.verse_15: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
verse.verse_16: And will not be absent thence.
verse.verse_17: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
verse.verse_18: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
verse.verse_19: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.
